name: Approved Private Investment Project

requirements.blocker_text: Law No. 8/2023 (Mozambique's new Private Investment Law, in force since 8 September 2023, replacing a ~30-year-old regime) guarantees equal treatment between Mozambican and foreign investors, security and protection of investments, and free movement of goods and capital, and expands eligible investment forms (including land-use-right transfers and technology/know-how contributions). The law's own text sets NO minimum capital threshold for foreign investors and contains NO confirmed residence-permit or visa benefit for the investor or staff -- implementing regulations were expected shortly after the law's entry into force but this dataset could not locate or fetch them, so it cannot confirm whether they add a residency benefit.
requirements.fix_path: Register an investment project under Law 8/2023 (no minimum capital confirmed in the law's own text; implementing regulations not located), then separately qualify for a residence authorization like any other foreign resident.

outcome.duration_length: tied to whichever residence authorization is separately obtained

sources.title: PLMJ (law firm) -- Mozambique's new Private Investment Law (Law 8/2023): scope, investor guarantees, no stated minimum capital or residency benefit in the base law
